Summary

Research-adjacent software engineer — three years building numerical and data-intensive systems, with a background in applied mathematics. Prior work spans simulation tooling, scientific workflow orchestration, and the unglamorous plumbing that makes an efficient pipeline stay efficient once it meets real data. Interested in roles where correctness matters more than velocity; comfortable reading a paper and shipping the thing it describes.

Selected Projects

quadfellow — adaptive quadrature library 2022 – present
github.com/ibergquist/quadfellow

A header-only C++ library implementing the stiﬀness-aware scheme from my thesis, with a thin Python wrapper. Used by two university groups and one aﬃliate lab; 430 stars. The documentation — written in a literate style — doubles as the reproducibility appendix for the 2022 paper.

plainmake — a reproducible-figures toolchain 2021 – 2023
bergquist.example.dev/plainmake

A small tool that turns a paper’s figure scripts into a single, cached, eﬃcient build graph, so “make figures” regenerates every plot from raw data in one step — or fails loudly.
